name: Charles Tyrwhitt
why: Jermyn Street quality at mail-order prices — the non-iron shirt at volume.
origin: Nicholas Charles Tyrwhitt Wheeler, 1986 — started by post from a Bristol student room; Jermyn Street shop 1997, Madison Avenue 2002.
opview: “Make it easy for men to dress well” — the house purpose, and the multibuy is the mechanism.

onething.n: verified — direct product page, $129 list and $74.75 on a multibuy, which is the house's actual pricing. Two-ply 100% cotton twill with the non-iron finish the brand was built on; classic, slim or extra slim, collar and sleeve sized separately. Made in Vietnam

notes.cotton: Two-ply Egyptian and long-staple cotton, and a non-iron finish applied to it
notes.fuss: Non-iron is the founding proposition, not a feature

cities: Jermyn Street flagship (London) · Madison Ave & select US stores · online-led
